title: Smoky Spanish Tortilla
description: A Mexican twist on the classic Spanish tortilla, adding smoky flavor from chipotle peppers.

ingredients.name: smoked chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
shredded cheese
ingredients.notes: such as queso fresco or Monterey Jack

instructions: In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the diced chipotle peppers and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tortilla pieces and cook until they start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked tortilla mixture to the bowl and stir in the cornmeal and shredded cheese.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9-inch (23cm) round baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
